name: Song Search
description: Search your downloaded songs with fuzzy matching, plus Jukebox NONG support.

disable-mod.name: Disable Song Search
disable-mod.description: Turn the search dialog off entirely and restore the default song browser.

nong-symbols.name: Show NONG symbols
nong-symbols.description: Draw Jukebox's pin disc on each song row's top-left corner; clicking it opens Jukebox's nong picker for that song. Requires Jukebox to be installed; does nothing without it.

issues.info: Report issues on the GitHub repository of this port.
